label: Whatever has power for the actual contingents' joint absence has one power
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation): whatever has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w has one power: all its active powers are one (the power-level aspect of simplicity; ST I q.19 a.4 ad 4, navigation). Not implied by an invariant set-up: a necessary being with a rational and a non-rational power is a model of its failure.
